decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program has its own page and required staff and regulatory investment in the core psychiatric offer, so management will keep it and attribute slow uptake to the start-up phase.

The carpentry workshop has sunk equipment costs, its own page and a clear link to the participation mission, so management keeps it despite modest sales, though the withdrawal of the retail shop shows the workshop line is not immune.
Outpatient sociotherapy fits the firm's announced outpatient direction and can still be framed as building referrals, but its low visibility leaves room for a quiet withdrawal.
The senior living counseling service is shown on the home page, is central to the eldercare direction and costs little, so the strong public commitment makes continuation very likely.

Meal delivery was launched only in 2024 and supports the firm's eldercare and outpatient concept, so weak early results will be attributed to the start-up phase, although it is only mentioned on the website.
